notes.title: Evenicle v1.04 Patch
notes.content:
Added an option to fix graphics if the screen is not refreshing properly 
(CONFIG - Window - Use Compatibility Mode)

Checking this is not necessary if you haven't experienced any graphical problems with your game.

You can check the version of your game from the help/about in your top menu.

notes.title: Evenicle v1.03 Patch
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33744217/10afb95fecff6c7ba3db25ef1c5c91a15442b168.jpg[/img]
The following updates have been made in this patch:
- Fixes the Steam Overlay
- No longer exits with an error message when loading corrupted global save files
- Option to use censored CGs
(The last page of your config/Game Settings)
- Some typo fixes

Please just let steam auto-update itself.
You can check the version of your game from the help/about in your top menu.
